label: a6-005-ex-the-ordinal-spaces-omega-plus-one-and-omega-one
tail:
I have read the item and all its declared dependencies adversarially. The mathematical proofs of claims 1–4 are valid under the stated assumptions, and all citations support the steps. No fatal defect was found in the logic or the mathematics. However, several remarks and sentences in the page contain unverifiable or factually incorrect claims. These are nonfatal to the core content but are defects in the published page.

### FINDING 1 — NONFATAL — location: Remarks, second bullet
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: "clauses 1, 2 and the T_3 property of both spaces are theorems of ZF ([[lem-ordinal-order-topology-is-t3]])"
WHY IT FAILS: The provided dependency [[lem-ordinal-order-topology-is-t3]] gives only the statement of the lemma, not its proof. Without the proof, it is impossible to verify that the lemma uses no choice principle, so the assertion that it is a theorem of ZF is unverifiable from the text supplied. The claim may be false if the lemma's proof uses some choice.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Either supply the proof of the lemma to confirm it requires no choice, or qualify the remark to say that the lemma's statement does not mention choice rather than flatly asserting it is ZF.

### FINDING 2 — NONFATAL — location: Remarks, third bullet
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: "why the plank argument on this page bounds a set of ordinals rather than taking a limit of a sequence"
WHY IT FAILS: The page contains no plank argument. It treats only the spaces ω+1 and [0,ω_1); no Tychonoff plank is constructed or discussed. The statement is factually incorrect.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Remove "on this page" or replace it with a correct reference to the item where the plank argument actually appears.

### FINDING 3 — NONFATAL — location: Example section, sentence after clause 4
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: "Clause 3 is the fact the deleted Tychonoff plank consumes"
WHY IT FAILS: This asserts a relationship with another library item (the deleted Tychonoff plank) that is not provided. We cannot verify that the plank item indeed uses clause 3 in the way stated. The claim is unverifiable from the given text.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Either provide the relevant excerpt from the Tychonoff plank item to confirm the claim, or remove the cross-reference.

0 fatal, 3 nonfatal
